scope_challenges_resolved: The current OSM owner1554 is a mixed-era whole-block ring; only source intersect(y>=36 OR x>=-18) is eligible for this delivery.
Dated OSM ways were paired with dated node versions, not present-day moved nodes; historic/current polygon differences were not labeled construction eras.
The unbuilt50m tower was excluded. An independent illustrated-section scale check supports a roughly19–20m old wall and20–21m local upper edge, explicitly not a survey.
The northeast porch/oriel, northwest two-storey Ionic arch and southeast through-passage were checked as three different features.

visual_review.observations: Whole historical C-shaped street-wing extent, separate concave corners and four estimated layers. Continuous lower street arches and strengthened middle-storey columns read distinctly; modern western body and contemporary roof pavilions are absent from this authored model.
Northeast open projecting folded porch and small curved glazed oriel are distinct from the northwest tall-arch corner. The court is open; roofs are explicitly approximate author closures.
Simpler pale courtyard elevations with rectangular windows, open western ends and plain artificial join closures are visible. No inferred courtyard block is added.

Actual unglazed southeast ground arch shows the bright courtyard beyond, with side returns and floor. This is supported by independent four traversing rays at low and upper-arch heights, both directions.

Northeast clustered-column open porch, separate curved glazed oriel and open upper balustrade are visible. Full/RAW retain internal window mullions; LOD omission is explicitly tested as recessed glass at the same ray point.

Northwest concave corner has a two-storey tall arched glazed opening, paired simplified Ionic columns, rectangular ground door and separate upper arch. It does not repeat the northeast porch or southeast passage.

necessary_v2_corrections: Removed southeast passage glass and cut the facing courtyard wall, with disclosed approximate corridor dimensions.
Changed ordinary ground street openings to true arched openings.
Strengthened middle-storey columns and added simplified Ionic capitals without adding unsupported ornamental complexity.
Replaced inherited limestone-specific material labels with neutral stone labels.

geometry.method: Reviewer independently decoded all delivered indexed triangles, including Meshopt buffers, and intersected the actual surfaces. The author construction functions and author probe rows were not imported.
geometry.negative_controls: Three source-free court boxes and four retained west/join points contain no new authored geometry; positive nearby roof/solid wall/arch shoulder/cap rays prevent a missing-model false pass.
geometry.arch_and_entry_controls: Independent rays reach actual upper curved glass portions and adjacent solid shoulders, northeast porch air/oriel glass/balustrade gap/cap, and traverse the southeast passage both ways at1.45m and4.02m for24m.
geometry.lod_difference: LOD deliberately removes internal mullions. The same independently selected mullion point reaches retained recessed glass at2.32m; RAW/full hit the frame at2.20m. This is recorded as explicit role-specific expectation, not identical detail.
geometry.native_reopen_and_texture_absence_eviden: Bound author native.json and packaged.json; reviewer inspected all six final renders and independently hashed the delivered native file.

placement.actual_source_decode: Complete own near group116292 triangles and far owner1554 plus four co-group owners168 selected triangles were independently decoded, including normalized instance rotations. Four retained roof rays in both original variants hit19.20000076m and remain outside the clip.
placement.foreign_context: All66 source neighbors and four own-group foreign components have zero overlap with new actual geometry/clip/collision within declared numeric tolerance. Six additional native groups use the mapper bound actual projections as an explicitly separate crosscheck.

collision_formula_replay.method: Replay on the frozen mapper raw union ring ordering, after independent triangle-union equivalence is checked below. Douglas-Peucker is sensitive to boundary start/order; that is distinct from occupied-plan geometry.

The frozen raw ring is independently shown to occupy exactly the same plan before its exact formula is replayed; all coverage/exclusion/buffer bounds are separately checked.

limitations: This is a photo-guided estimated exterior, not measured restoration geometry.
The completed work is the bounded street-wing model; the whole listed b1-019 site and historical courtyard building scope are not marked complete.
Plain joining end walls and roof closures are disclosed author estimates.
Collision uses the complete horizontal projection including roofs, so a verified visual passage does not imply traversable gameplay.
Final global integration, sprites at all required zooms and real page screenshots require the separately run browser QA.
